[b]ERENE WORLD CUP 2027 MATCHDAY ONE![/b]
[i]Short introduction of the tournament[/i]

[i]After the teams of 32 countries traveled to Valddera to play the tournament, with 11 stadiums along with the tournament that will be played on. The fans start coming in the stands of Azarkhvsar National Stadium. Ready to view the first opening match of the tournament, Valddera the hosts vs a strong defensive side, Gythena.[/i]

[Spoiler=Valddera vs Gythena]Both teams line up for the kick off at the start of the game, fans from all around the world excited for the first match of the Erene world cup. The match kicks off with the Valdderan team gaining strong possesion over the first half, around the extra time of the first half, 45+2 minutes. Valddera get a corner kick, as Hares Khalduni, the defensive midfield box to box player for Valddera, steps up to take it with his mastery in set pieces, he lobs it through the air into the box, it doesn't reach anybody's head until Valdderan midfielder Daoud Sarvendari, quickly strikes the ball from the right edge of the box into the bottom right corner with a first touch shoot as the ball lands on his feet. Going through players' legs and gracefully entering the net which marks the first goal of the Erene world cup, quickly going to celebrate with his teammates. As the game continues, Valddera manages to keep the game stable until the end of the 90 minutes, marking the first match of the tournament with a Valdderan victory.

Valddera 1 - 0 Gythena
Daoud 47'

Match summary: https://postimg.cc/sMDWjPPP
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Italian Dutch vs Hathipur]Just an hour after the opening match of the Tournament, the second game in the competition kicks off, with the nation of Italia going against the state of Hathipur, formally part of the Dakshinese state, the match goes off with Italian dutch fairly competing against Hathipuran squad, with both goalkeepers making great saves for their team with a great performance from Hathipuran goalkeeper, Vineet Thakore. In the second half, a corner kick comes for the Hathipuran team in the 81th minute, but that moment was decisive as Prem Bhardvaj kicks it off as it lands on Hathipurian defender Chander Bhalavkar's head and goes quickly in the net, the Hathipuran fans celebrate their late goal from the corner kick spot. Little do they know, just 9 minutes later in the 90th minute, Italia's team quickly counters in a mistake from Hathipur and reaches the half of Hathipur, Italia's striker quickly shoots it as it rebounds into Hathipuran defender Chhotu Bhave into his own net in which counted as an own goal, a turning point in the dying moments of the match and the moment that marks the full time as a draw for Hathipur and Italian dutch.

Italian Dutch 1 - 1 Hathipur
Bhave (OG) 90' -  Chander 81'
Player (14)
(Yellow card)      - Shudraka (Yellow card)

Match summary: https://postimg.cc/bsv6MnDr
[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Hyperea vs Sanguivallis]In the same day around afternoon, the third match of the day begins, both two refined and decent teams against eachother even though Sanguivallis was more likely to win against the underdogs of Hyperea, the Hypereans suprisingly held well in the first half and managed to score by a penalty in the second half, as Sanguiva player fouled the Hyperean striker in the penalty box, the referee quickly marks a penalty for Hyperea as the Striker number 6 steps up to take it, he quickly shoots and blasts it top corner as the crowd roars in celebration of the 72nd minute goal by their striker, Hyperea would continue on blocking and defending against Sanguivallis well until the end of the match where it marks the end of the match with an unexpected win from Hyperea.

Sanguivallis 0 - 1 Hyperea

[Spoiler=Vespurias vs Thyven]Around night after the third match of Hyperea vs Sanguivallis, a long awaited match finally kicked off finally for all suspended fans on the currently biggest Stadium in Valddera, Shahrestan Olympic Stadium with a capacity of 100,000 people thanks to being bought and renovated by a foreign owner, the match officially kicks off surprisingly heated from the start as Vespurian player Hadrian Morgan tackles Thyven's number 10 in a nasty clash, the Thyven player falls on the ground as the referee gives Hadrian Morgan a straight red card for the actions, now, Vespurias was only playing with 10 players from already 12 minutes. in the 37th minute, Vespurian striker Josen Malines gets a lobbed ball from the left side of outside the box and quickly shoots it powerfully as Thyrom goalkeeper doesn't get the hand to it and beautifully enters the right top corner, the Vespurian fans rise in chants as Josen Malines celebrates his goal infront of the filled up stands. As Vespurias continue to dominate the first half, just 3 minutes later from Josen Malines's goal, Vespurias get a 25 yard free kick from the Thyrom goal net, Josen steps up to take it and decides to gracefully strike it into the net to mark his second goal of the match, two amazing goals in just the first half as Thyrom player's argue with the referee that the free kick in the first place shouldn't have counted but the referee quickly silents them by giving two yellow cards for Thyrom players. The Second half officially kicks off after a break with Thyven players looking more determined than ever, unfortunately that determination comes with aggresion as Thyrom defender tackles the Vespurian Striker Josen Malines, with the Referee giving the Thyven player a straight red card with no hestiation, the vespurian midfielder Danver Stent taunts the sent off Thyven player as they go with a heated fight together, the Referee sends off Danver Stent and kicks them out of the pitch quickly. The Match continues with around three sent off players from both teams and alot of yellow cards. Thyven manages to score a goal in the 57th minute from a simple tap in from Thyrom striker, that makes the score 2-1, but Thyven still needed atleast 2 to beat them, just 21 minutes later in the 78th minute, Thyrom midfielder manages to strike a shot outside the box powerfully into the net, equalizing the match and bringing back hope for fans and players, the match continues on with no winner decided yet until the 83rd minute, when Thyrom defender hits back a header coming from a corner kick into the goal, marking a historical comeback for Thyven, the game continues on but Vespurias fail to equalize which results in a victory for Thyven and the last match of opening day.

Vespurias 2 - 3 Thyven

[spoiler=[b]Dravahn IV  King of Dzahayra[/b]]

[i]Dravahn IV is the current king of Dzahayra, having ruled since the death of his father in 2006. He is part of a dynastic family that has controlled the country through both fear and reform since the 1700s. His father and grandfather before him are wildley considered reformers when compared to most other historic Dzahayran kings, and Dravahn IV has, for the most part, continued with and advanced these reforms.

 While he has accepted and given more power to the indepdenent parliament of the country and other democratic institutions, he still keep a strong grip on the country and very much intends to stay in power and continue. The tactics have changed, but core idea of continued Dynastic control remains; the new Kings opt for keeping control through social security and the appearance of being benevolent fathers of the nation.

This has been achieved by the King heavily favoring more subtle propaganda and essentially turning the country into a welfare state. While in the past, the monarchy ensured stability and loyalty by giving nobles land and power and luxuury; Today, it switches it around and seeks to keep loyalty by cracking down corruption, nobles, and corporations while investing in things like National Insurance, Universal Healthcare, and assistance for things such as food aid and education.This has made the King a very popular ruler despite the fact that polls aren't really truthworthy
[/i]
[/spoiler]
TLDR: My leader is essentially a benevolent dictator.

[spoiler=Baladullahs stance on new developments in Tirakan and Valddera, and a Call for Shamatine Cooperation][b]ATK
(Office of the Sultan, 
Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 
Ministry of Defense)[/b]

[u]Baladullah Welcomes the Developments in Tirakan and Valddera, Offers Assistance to New Governments
[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

The Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah congratulates the popular forces and their allies in [nation]Tirakan[/nation] and [nation]Valddera[/nation] in the establishment of true popular sovereignty and constitutional government in their previously fractured and war torn lands. The establishment of peace, reconciliation, and inclusive governance are critically important when any country emerges from conflict, and in shaa Allah these things will be established and consolidated by the new authorities of these countries.

We also wish to offer economic and humanitarian aid to these countries to assist them in their redevelopment and reconstruction processes. Whatever they need, we are willing and able to provide, in shaa Allah.

As a final note, we urge these countries, and all Shamatine nations, to not allow foreign interference in their politics or the establishment of any imperialist designs on our lands. It is our opinion that the expansion of the Shamatine Security Pact (SSP) and increased political, economic, and military cooperation amongst all Shamatine nations would bring all our countries great collective and individual benefits. We are not opposed to relations with the entire world, of course, and seek peaceful and mutually beneficial relations with all nations. However, as we are a Shamatine nation rooted in the culture and tradition of Shamatine peoples, we seek to uplift and assist those in our neighborhood first and foremost, so to speak. May peace be with you all.

[i]Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi
Foreign Minister Abdoul Mahonomayi
Defense Minister Musa al-Yahudiyyah[/i][/spoiler]
